page.overview:
What is Hop?

Hop is character appearing in . He is the player character's neighborhood friend and rival, who eventually becomes Sonia's research assistant, after the latter takes her grandmother, Professor Magnolia's place, as the region's professor. He is also the brother of Leon.

Hop has a youthful, energetic appearance that perfectly reflects his spirited and determined personality. He has warm brown skin, expressive golden eyes, thick eyebrows, and a cheerful smile that often accompanies his enthusiastic nature. His dark purple hair is styled into a high, tousled wave, giving him a playful look. With a slim, athletic build and an active posture, Hop is rarely seen standing still, always appearing eager for his next adventure. His overall appearance captures the optimism and ambition of a young Trainer striving to forge his own path.

Hop's clothing is casual, sporty, and practical, suited to his active lifestyle. He wears a teal-blue jacket with cream shearling trim over a maroon t-shirt, paired with black trousers featuring subtle purple stripes. Purple and black trainers provide comfort for travelling across Galar, while a green-and-black crossbody satchel carries his Trainer essentials. Altogether, his outfit balances style and functionality, perfectly complementing his energetic personality and journey as an aspiring Pokémon Trainer.

Hop's personality is enthusiastic, determined, and full of heart. As the younger brother of Champion Leon, he starts his journey eager to follow in his brother's footsteps, often expressing boundless energy and confidence. He's friendly, upbeat, and deeply passionate about Pokémon battles, always looking for ways to improve and prove himself. Though he can be impulsive and a bit headstrong at times, Hop is also resilient—when faced with setbacks or loss, he reflects on them and uses those experiences to grow stronger. Throughout his journey, he matures noticeably, shifting from wanting to simply become the next Champion to discovering his own unique path. Hop's loyalty, optimism, and personal growth make him not only a fierce rival but also a deeply relatable and admirable character.
